entities.title: Submissions and the scores page
entities.summary: A replayed game is scored once; made-up or mismatched submissions are refused; the page escapes names.
criteria: The API issues a seed, scores a replayed two-player game once, only for the player who gave a name, and lists it on the API and the page
Made-up controls and a wrong number of names are refused with 422, bad names with 400 and an unknown seed with 409, and the seed stays usable
The web page lists the scores, escapes names and carries the site's footer

checks.symbol: the API issues a seed, scores a replayed two-player game once, and lists it
the API refuses made-up controls, wrong player counts and bad names, and keeps the seed usable
the high-score web page lists the scores, escapes names, and carries the site's footer

notChecked: Real D1: the tests stand in for it with an object that understands only the statements index.ts uses.
That an unused seed expires after 24 hours.

entities.title: Sign-in
entities.summary: The page and the score API need a sign-in.
criteria: Someone signed out is sent to sign in, and back to the same address
The page is served privately to anyone signed in
A new game or a score needs a sign-in, and an unreachable login service counts as signed out

checks.symbol: sign-in: the game's page sends someone signed out to sign in, and back
sign-in: the page is served to anyone signed in, privately
sign-in: a new game or a score needs a sign-in; the login service out of reach is signed out
